question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

He has a __nasty__ habit of picking his nose.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Despicable**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Nasty**" is used to describe something disgusting or unpleasant. (घिनौना) 

 
 
• **Example**- He has a nasty habit of picking his nose in public.
 
 
 
• "**Despicable**" refers to something deserving hatred and contempt. (नीच)
 
 
• **Example**- His despicable behavior made everyone avoid him.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that is similar in meaning to the given word is 'Despicable’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• "**Laudable**" means deserving praise and commendation. (प्रशंसनीय)
 
• "**Indolent**" refers to someone wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy. (आलसी)
 
• "**Cowardly**" describes someone who is lacking courage. (कायर)
